description: Each PR adds small JSON files under `features/catalog/` (a feature's current state) and `features/changes/` (one immutable entry per PR). `FEATURES.md`, `features/index.json` and `features/schema.json` are generated from them at merge time and are never hand-edited. This is a per-change log, not release notes; the GitHub release body stays the release record.
examples: Answer what shipped in a release, feature by feature, without reading the git log.
how_to: Every PR adds a change entry; features.py check --branch enforces it before merge.
media_exempt: repository tooling with no screen in the app
name: Feature catalog and update log
summary: A per-change, machine-readable record of what the product does and what changed, generated at merge time.
where: In the repository: features/ and the generated FEATURES.md.
